task.description:
WF-02, step 1 — write the design of REQ-106 (end-to-end tests of Pixel Office in a real headless Chrome) in docs/design/REQ-106-e2e-pixel-office.md, by the section "Step 1" of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md. No implementation code in the design: shapes, signatures, tables only.

READ FIRST: the block REQ-106 in docs/requirements.yaml (all 8 criteria; read by id, the file is large); docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md (the starter stand.js, its sections 4 and 21 "As built") and docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md (the kit API, section 21) — the code in tools/test/e2e/kit/ is the truth, read it too (stand.js, index.js, browser.js, errors.js, runner.js); decisions/0107, 0108, 0109 (all addenda, especially О15, and the lessons of О17–О23), 0110; docs/quality-bar.md; docs/anti-patterns.md (especially AP-140 to AP-149); the README sections of Pixel Office ("Pixel Office", "Where things are", "What of the hook input is stored", "The journal in plain words") and tools/src/pixel-office/ (main.js, hook.sh and what it calls, protocol.js, public/schema.js, public/texts.js, the role-name table of decision 0055); tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js and smoke.e2e.js as models of a spec file; docs/issues/ISS-0105, ISS-0107, ISS-0108, ISS-0110 (open kit defects; say whether this design touches them, do not fix them here).

WHAT THE DESIGN MUST SETTLE: (1) The precondition О15 of decisions/0109, before anything else: every stand gets a private temporary home folder (the child's HOME is set to a new folder under the temporary root, so that Node's home lookup cannot reach the real one), and state folders reach the server only through checked pairs "variable -> folder" and through checked folder arguments (Pixel Office also takes its folder from --dir: check it the same way or forbid it); the starter refuses before any process is started when a folder is outside the temporary root (criterion 1 counts spawned processes: 0). This changes the released starter tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js and its tests: design the change of the interface, the failure paths, the clean-up, and the tests of the starter (tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js) that must change "was -> became" (for example the tests that today assert the child gets no HOME: E2S-05, E2S-19, E2K-50 — check on the tag which ones), without weakening any prohibition (AP-068, AP-112, AP-113). (2) The structure of tools/test/e2e/pixel-office.e2e.js: one test per criterion 1–7 and the time/independence criterion 8, each test with its own server and folders; how events are sent only through the real hook program with the two environment variables; how the time of an event is proven to come from the hook; the mask test with the key-shaped text built from parts at run time; the measurement of the real state folder before and after (criterion 5, which RELEASE-VALIDATOR measures, and what the spec itself may assert); the reconnect test on the same port (state how a port taken by another process in between is handled without a wait by time and without a flaky result). (3) Re-check every fact the requirement lists as "checked on 2026-11-03" (POLL_MS, POLL_TIMEOUT_MS, MASK_LABEL, the connection words, prepareText, ROLE_NAMES, the README word table, the five files of "Where things are") on the tag base/E2E106-20261115-01 and write the command, the output and the date; a fact that changed is an open question, not a silent fix. (4) A time budget: criterion 8 says 50000 ms at most; measured runner times of the picker spec were about 1.2–1.35 times the local ones (20035–22050 ms on the runner against about 16.5 s on the Mac, handoffs of run E2E105-20261105-01); state how the file stays under the limit on the runner, measured with a sketch, and do not take a timing of one machine as a fact of another (AP-144, ISS-0103). (5) The kit calls that exist and any missing kit call (as a change of the kit with its own tests, not a silent edit). (6) The replacement table of earlier guard tests (search tools/test/ for tests that read tools/test/e2e, count files, read README rows or the starter's behaviour) and the shared places (the README table row made by REQ-104, tools/package.json if the runner selects files by name, the order check of spec files of ISS-0102). (7) Lessons of the last run to apply from the start: an exemption must be as narrow as its reason and pinned with what it covers; a check read once at the end misses what removes itself before it; a page check must read the text the visitor reads (AP-145).

Check every statement about the current system with a sketch outside the project (a fresh clone of the tag base/E2E106-20261115-01, npm ci, then dummy files) and write the command, the output and the date. The text of the design must hold no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner (traces and handoffs-check fail on them). Mutants: at least 25, each with the test that catches it, covering both the starter change and the spec. The section about the bar: Q1–Q14 and R1–R3, each "applicable: how" or "not applicable: why" (R2 is central: the owner's real Pixel Office folder must never be touched). Open questions go as a list О1, О2, … with a default, not settled by a guess.

result.summary: The design of REQ-106 is written in docs/design/REQ-106-e2e-pixel-office.md. It settles decisions/0109 O15 first, as a change of the released starter tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js: every stand gets a home folder of its own (HOME and USERPROFILE point to <marker folder>/home under the temporary root, so os.homedir() in the server cannot reach the real home folder); a state folder reaches a server only through the new option stateEnv (checked pairs variable -> folder) or as an argument; every absolute path in stateEnv, in a value of env and in an argument (also after '=', as in --dir=<path>) must lie under the temporary root, not be the root itself and lie outside the repository, else PATH_REFUSED before anything is made or spawned (criterion 1: 0 spawns); stateDirs is refused with USAGE; a server that wrote into its home folder fails stop() with the new code STAND_HOME_WRITTEN. The stand-in gets the home in its env event and a mode write-home that can never write outside the temporary root. The spec tools/test/e2e/pixel-office.e2e.js has seven tests, one per criterion 1-7 (isolated start, live, journal, mask, untouched home, reconnect, windows); criterion 8 is proved by commands. Events go only through the real hook program, run by a spec helper with exactly PATH, SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR and HOME, both folders checked in the same call; the spec never reads the real state folder. The restart test tells three outcomes of a port taken in between apart by facts (no wait, no retry). All facts of 2026-11-03 hold on the tag (one precision of place: prepareText is defined in mask.js and called by protocol.js). A prototype of the whole change and of the spec ran in fresh clones of the tag: the spec 22.0-22.2 s on this Mac (limit 50 s; about 14.3 s of it is the page's own 2 s poll), the runner estimated at about 25 s and at most about 37 s from REQ-105's measured ratios; 56 mutants listed, 55 applied in a sketch, 51 caught by the tests of this work, 4 survivors of the spec caught by named unit tests. The real state folder of this computer was not touched (the same sha256 and size before the first trial and after the last). 17 open questions for ORCH, each with a default.

issues.text: O1 (proposal for a record, e.g. decisions/0112-e2e-pixel-office-conventions.md, or an addendum to 0109 O15): the change of the released starter — stateEnv replaces stateDirs (refused with USAGE), rule P on stateEnv, env values and args (one pinned exemption: an absolute script inside the repository as the first argument), the private home <marker>/home with HOME and USERPROFILE, the code STAND_HOME_WRITTEN and its place in the precedence (CLEANUP_FAILED > STAND_HOME_WRITTEN > STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT > STAND_EXIT); choices C-1..C-4. Default: as design section 4.1.

O2: the hook's HOME is a folder of the test (makeTempDir('hook-home')), not the stand's home, because the hook must run while no stand exists (reconnect); 'the same two variables' read as the same two names. Default: as stated.

O3: criterion 7 says 'the kit reports no console error'; the browser writes one favicon 404 line per start (F15; the server serves no icon). Default: declare it exactly with its path once per start, as REQ-105 (decisions/0109 O4); the criterion read as 'the kit reports none'.

O4: in reconnect every failed poll writes net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for /api/events; the count depends on the polls. Default: expect (at least one, no upper bound) with the path; nothing else allowed (the stop comes right after a poll answer, so no request is in flight).

O5: a port taken by another process between the stop and the restart (about 2.1 s; on Linux even a self-connection of the browser's poll can hold it). Default: the three outcomes told apart by facts (2 start rows and the port file = ours; STAND_START_EXITED with 'Порт <n> занят' = foreign; link but 1 start row = another Pixel Office), a taken port fails with its cause named, no retry, no other port, no wait. The alternative (a fixed port outside the ephemeral ranges) leaves '--port 0' of the block: a WF-01 micro-amendment.

O6: criterion 5 gets the spec test 'untouched home' (the event lands in the temporary folder, both homes empty, stop() code 0); the hash of the real folder stays RELEASE-VALIDATOR's measurement and the spec never reads the real folder (a hash inside the spec would be flaky when a real session writes during a check). Default: as stated; RV greps new lines of the real journal for the prefix e2e106- if the hash changed.

O7: 'the time came from the hook' — the spec proves 'inside the window of its own hook run, payload without time'; that the server keeps the sent time is the unit test SV-04b (mutant P07 survives the spec, red in SV-04b). Default: accepted and recorded.

O8: the mask test reads more places than criterion 4 names (every attribute, document.title, the address, the storage, the /api/events answers the page got, the server's stdout and stderr) — AP-145 item 1; P34 is the mutant of 'server output'. Default: as stated.
O9: criterion 7 'the block «Сейчас» exists' read as 'is shown and starts with «Сейчас»' (mutant P24, display:none in narrow windows, is red only so). Default: as stated.

O10: the line for a question on the runner: 30000 ms (60 % of 50000, the rule of decisions/0109 O11); the alternative 40000 (80 %) because about 15 s of the file are the product's poll. Default: 30000.

O11: the block names (tools/src/pixel-office/protocol.js, prepareText); prepareText is defined in mask.js:294 (since 596abbf, 2026-10-06) and called by protocol.js:97 and :176. Default: DOC-UPDATER corrects the words at step 10 without a change of meaning.

O12: the block says 'Guard tests of earlier requirements, was -> became: none … no existing assertion counts files of tools/test'. Measured: E2S-01, E2S-03, E2S-05 turn red by the starter change (F23); E2S-02, E2S-19, E2K-41, E2K-60 get words or cases, E2K-50 gets the SCANNED entry (design section 12). Also the task's example 'the tests that today assert the child gets no HOME: E2S-05, E2S-19, E2K-50': only E2S-05 asserts it; E2S-19 and E2K-50 check which variables the kit files read, not the child's environment, and stay as they are in that rule. Default: the edits of section 12; DOC-UPDATER corrects the sentence at step 10 with before_copy.
O13: the private home inside the marker folder (reuses the exit handler and the runner's sweep; the sai-e2e-* folder count of the released tests stays 1 per stand). Default: as stated.

O14: rule P refuses an absolute path inside the repository in env; the block of REQ-107 says SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN points to a trap in tools/test/fixtures/e2e/. Default: no exemption now; the design of REQ-107 copies the trap under the temporary root or asks for a pinned exemption with a record.

O15: the spec imports ROLE_NAMES from src/pixel-office/public/texts.js (the requirement's own words) while WF-02 step 5 says a test does not import rules from src; the words of the rows come from the README. Default: the import of the data table, as the requirement says.
O16: os.userInfo() still names the real home folder whatever HOME is (F13); no server of Sai asks it. Default: recorded in design 4.1; a later server that asked it would need a change of the kit.
O17: the mutants and the anti-pattern candidates (I18) are recorded by DOC-UPDATER at step 10 from this list. Default: as stated.

For docs/anti-patterns.md (Q13): (1) a starter that checks a folder but does not hand that same value to the child proves nothing (O15, F14); (2) os.userInfo() names the real home folder whatever HOME is (F13); (3) a kit test whose stand-in writes into 'the home folder' must be built so that a broken starter makes it write nothing (design 4.2); (4) a foreign server on the same port shows the same page, so the identity is read from our own folder before the page (F11); (5) a hash of a shared real file read inside a test is flaky when real sessions write to it (C-6); (6) a key-shaped test text can be masked by a second rule, so the shape of the input needs its own control (R06 survived without it).

docs/issues/ISS-0110: STAND_HOME_WRITTEN puts the entry names of a home folder through safeText, one more caller that would show a bidirectional control unescaped (design section 20); not fixed here. docs/issues/ISS-0102 item 2 can be continued with three real files (F26, design section 13). ISS-0105, ISS-0107, ISS-0108 are not touched (section 20).
